abilities.name: One With the Shadows
abilities.text: After this Unit fully resolves an Action, it gains the HIDDEN Status.

abilities.name: Prophetic Vision
abilities.text: REPEATABLE. Use when this Unit is selected as the target of an attack. This Unit's Evade characteristic is treated as 4+ against this attack and cannot be modified.

abilities.name: Sentenced to Death
abilities.text: Target Enemy Unit on the battlefield. Whenever Zeratul makes a Close Combat Attack targeting the selected Unit, its weapon gains CRITICAL HIT (2).

abilities.name: Void Prison
abilities.text: Set a Faction Indicator on the battlefield Within 8″ of this Unit. While Enemy Units are Within 2″ of this Faction Indicator they suffer DEBUFF Speed (2).

abilities.name: Void Blink
abilities.text: If Unengaged, resolve the PLACE (6) effect.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (4) 4+ effect.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.text: All Enemy Units Engaged with this Unit suffer HITS 4 (1).
